_comment: Generated from Car_disassembly_animation_f0a51cd2_1080p.mp4 via scripts/convert-frames.sh. Single continuous 10s/24fps source clip, resampled to every 2nd decoded frame (120 frames total) and scaled down for web delivery. Two resolution variants are provided: the default 1280-wide set and a lighter 800-wide set (directory 'disassembly-sm') for small/low-bandwidth viewports.
_chapterNote: Chapter order and hold frames are matched to what the single supplied clip actually shows, not forced into the brief's alphabetical B-C-D-E listing: the hood/engine bay opens before the front bumper and wheels visibly separate in the source footage, so 'engine' precedes 'front' and 'wheels' in on-screen scroll order here. The clip does not show the engine lifting out as a separate component -- the engine chapter uses the open-hood/exposed-engine-bay pose, not an extraction.

reassembly._comment: Not a separate asset -- the same frame files are replayed from frameCount down to 1 (then stays on frame 1, the uncovered assembled car; the cover image is never reapplied).
